headline: AutoStore raises 2026 revenue forecast following Q3 sales growth
summary: AutoStore has increased its 2026 revenue guidance after reporting a jump in sales during the third quarter.
why: Revenue guidance updates are primary drivers for valuation adjustments in growth-oriented technology and industrial companies.

impacts.name: AutoStore
impacts.why: Upward revision of revenue guidance typically leads to positive market sentiment.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Investors typically adjust valuations upward when a company reports strong quarterly performance and raises future revenue expectations.
